title: Suno stem separation options
summary: Official Pro/Premier documentation includes Get Stems, and credits may apply to advanced split modes. MCP feature parity, plans, credit costs and permissions must be probed.

build.target: Produce an eligible owned clip's separated instrumental parts to test stem-based musical continuity.
requires: Signed-in user owns or may access the source clip
Official stems grant, enough user-approved credits
Audio retrieval and a local mixer for continuity tests
inputs: Completed source clip ID and requested split mode (two or twelve)
outputs: Stem group and returned clip IDs with completion status
Candidate isolated drum or instrumental bridge for local inspection
execute: Check that the source clip is complete and that account grants permit stems.
Estimate feature-specific credit cost from live server description; obtain explicit approval.
Request the narrowest supported stem split, with idempotent retry key if provided.
Poll the stem group until terminal status and record partial failures.
Inspect isolated parts and report artifacts; use local mixing for DJ transitions instead of assuming generation will be immediate.

applies_when: A drum/instrumental bridge is needed between authorized songs.
The source audio is owned and eligible under current Suno plan.
avoid_when: The source clip is not finished or not authorized for stem splitting.
The plan lacks required feature or the cost exceeds approved budget.

operator: Respect provider-specific costs and do not assume every part exists.
Stems may be delayed or partial; keep playback independent of generation.

stop_when: Stem group reaches complete/partial/error with a documented receipt.
Stop on permission, quota or budget failure.

checks: Link each stem ID and inspect audible isolation artifacts.
A completed split does not establish a seamless DJ transition.
